title: Greeks on degenerate inputs, finite and float64
source:
import math, os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import norm
o = pd.read_parquet("/input/environment/data/options.parquet")
prices, deltas = [], []
for row in o.itertuples(index=False):
    S, K, T, r, s = float(row.S), float(row.K), float(row.T), float(row.r), float(row.sigma)
    kind = str(row.option_type).lower()
    dk = K * math.exp(-r * T)
    sq = s * math.sqrt(T)
    if sq < 1e-7:
        # T -> 0 or sigma -> 0: the value is the discounted-strike intrinsic, delta its subgradient.
        if kind == "call":
            p, d = max(S - dk, 0.0), (1.0 if S > dk else 0.0)
        else:
            p, d = max(dk - S, 0.0), (-1.0 if S < dk else 0.0)
    else:
        d1 = (math.log(S / K) + (r + s * s / 2) * T) / sq
        d2 = d1 - sq
        if kind == "call":
            p, d = S * norm.cdf(d1) - dk * norm.cdf(d2), norm.cdf(d1)
        else:
            p, d = dk * norm.cdf(-d2) - S * norm.cdf(-d1), norm.cdf(d1) - 1.0
    if kind == "call":
        p, d = min(max(p, 0.0), S), min(max(d, 0.0), 1.0)
    else:
        p, d = min(max(p, 0.0), dk), min(max(d, -1.0), 0.0)
    prices.append(p)
    deltas.append(d)
out = pd.DataFrame({"option_id": o["option_id"], "price": np.array(prices, dtype="float64"),
                    "delta": np.array(deltas, dtype="float64")})
assert np.isfinite(out[["price", "delta"]].to_numpy()).all()
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
out.to_parquet("/app/output/greeks.parquet", index=False)
